select.foreach: select * from common_course_chapter where courseid=#{item.courseId} and id = #{item.chapterId}

if.foreach: select knowledgeContentId from common_course_knowledge where id =#{item}

insert.foreach: insert into common_course_knowledge_record (questionid, studenterid, correct, knowledgeid, questiontype, courseId, answer, questionTypeByfunction,starttime,endtime) values (#{item.questionId},#{item.studenterId},#{item.correct},(select knowledgeId from common_knowledge_question where knowledgeContentId =#{item.knowId} limit 1),#{item.type}, #{item.courseId},#{item.correctOption},1,now(),now())

mapper.select: select id as questionId, knowledgeid AS knowId, choicea AS optionA, choiceb AS optionB, choicec AS optionC, choiced as optionD, rightaws as correctOption, resolving, title as question, isgb, schoolid, subjectid, questionImage, 1 as type from common_course_choice where id=( select questionId from common_knowledge_question where questionType=1 and knowledgeContentId =#{knowledge} limit 1 )

select id as questionId, knowledgeid as knowId, title as question, resolving, rightaws as correctOption, isgb, schoolid, subjectid, questionImage, 3 as type from common_course_judge WHERE id=( select questionId from common_knowledge_question where questionType=3 and knowledgeContentId =#{knowledge} limit 1)
